titleEn: Maximum Points in an Archery Competition
title: 射箭比赛中的最大得分
summary: Bob 有固定箭数，某区得箭数严格多于 Alice 才获得该区分数，求任一最高分箭数分配。
insight: 只有十二个计分区，枚举获胜区域子集；赢下 i 区的最少成本为 alice[i]+1。可行子集中取分数和最大者，剩余箭随意放到零分区。
pitfalls: 零分区获胜也不增加分数
同分方案可返回任意一个

solutions.title: 枚举获胜区域子集
solutions.idea: 每个区域只需考虑是否投入刚好超过 Alice 的最低箭数。
steps: mask 从零到 2^12-1，计算 required 与 score
required<=numArrows 且 score>best 时保存各胜区 alice[i]+1
把 numArrows-required 的剩余箭加到 answer[0]

code.java: class Solution { public int[] maximumBobPoints(int numArrows,int[] aliceArrows){int best=-1;int[] answer=new int[12];for(int mask=0;mask<(1<<12);mask++){int required=0,score=0;for(int i=0;i<12;i++)if((mask&(1<<i))!=0){required+=aliceArrows[i]+1;score+=i;}if(required<=numArrows&&score>best){best=score;Arrays.fill(answer,0);for(int i=0;i<12;i++)if((mask&(1<<i))!=0)answer[i]=aliceArrows[i]+1;answer[0]+=numArrows-required;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumBobPoints(numArrows:Int,aliceArrows:IntArray):IntArray{var best=-1;var answer=IntArray(12);for(mask in 0 until (1 shl 12)){var required=0;var score=0;for(i in 0 until 12)if(mask and (1 shl i)!=0){required+=aliceArrows[i]+1;score+=i};if(required<=numArrows&&score>best){best=score;answer=IntArray(12);for(i in 0 until 12)if(mask and (1 shl i)!=0)answer[i]=aliceArrows[i]+1;answer[0]+=numArrows-required}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> maximumBobPoints(int numArrows,vector<int>& aliceArrows){int best=-1;vector<int> answer(12);for(int mask=0;mask<(1<<12);++mask){int required=0,score=0;for(int i=0;i<12;++i)if(mask>>i&1){required+=aliceArrows[i]+1;score+=i;}if(required<=numArrows&&score>best){best=score;fill(answer.begin(),answer.end(),0);for(int i=0;i<12;++i)if(mask>>i&1)answer[i]=aliceArrows[i]+1;answer[0]+=numArrows-required;}}return answer;} };
